name: Loan Eligibility - C Grouped Email Delivery

parameters.query: WITH demo_targets AS (SELECT user_id::uuid, lower(recipient) AS recipient FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(user_id text, recipient text)), notification_matches AS (SELECT m.upload_batch_id, m.user_id, u.email, u.name AS user_name, coalesce(dt.recipient, u.email) AS delivery_recipient, p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, m.decision, m.reasons, false AS no_match FROM matches m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN loan_products p ON p.id = m.loan_product_id LEFT JOIN demo_targets dt ON dt.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.upload_batch_id = $1 AND m.decision IN ('eligible', 'may_qualify', 'unknown') AND (jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb) = 0 OR dt.user_id IS NOT NULL)) SELECT * FROM notification_matches UNION ALL SELECT $1::uuid, NULL::uuid, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, '[]'::jsonb, true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_matches) ORDER BY user_id NULLS LAST, product_id NULLS LAST LIMIT $3;
